page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the ecs.g5ne.2xlarge delivers moderate to weak performance across several compute and memory workloads. Single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests place the instance in the bottom 25% of performance, which is mirrored by a Geekbench single-core score of 935.0 and a multi-core score of 3539.0. Memory bandwidth write operations on large blocks are average, reaching 34.64 GB/sec, while read-only large block bandwidth is weaker at 38.97 GB/sec. The instance demonstrates average performance in Redis SET operations, processing 5.91 million operations per second, and in small-model LLM inference, achieving 98.99 tokens per second for text generation on a 135M model. However, performance drops significantly for larger models, with a 7B model yielding only 4.84 tokens per second.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.g5ne.2xlarge represents a standard general-purpose tier. It is qualitatively suited for workloads that require dedicated resources but do not demand high-frequency compute or massive memory bandwidth. Appropriate workloads include moderate web serving, Redis caching, lightweight database operations, and small-scale application hosting where predictable CPU allocation is preferred over burstable performance.
